decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box extends the firm's core fluid-handling and utility business, required little extra investment to launch, and has only been on the market since 2024, so weak early sales can still be blamed on a temporary ramp-up.

Public waste bins sit far from the core business and carry the most risk, but the firm committed publicly with a multi-model line that fits its stated aim of broadening markets, so after only one year management would hold on and attribute slow uptake to public procurement cycles.
The ground sleeve line is built on existing steel and casting know-how and was invested in as several models, so the firm will persist with it to justify the launch.
Cast iron ground sleeves complement the visible sleeve line and use established capabilities, and dropping them would weaken the range the firm has publicly committed to.
Steel ground sleeves fit directly into the firm's core steel processing and in-house coating expertise, so there is no reason to abandon them so soon after launch.
